top_signals.title: UK Energy Bills Set to Jump 25%: Bloomberg Economics
top_signals.summary: UK energy bills could jump 25% in January, Bloomberg Economics finds, threatening to undo much of prime minister Andy Burnham’s effort to ease the cost-of-living squeeze. Nicole Sy explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
